mq-18.message:
Based on the search results, it appears that the volume discounts and pricing for Acme and Stonebridge Orchards are as follows:

For Acme:

* The Premium Operations Plan includes up to three implementation sessions per year at no extra cost.
* Each additional site is billed at 70% of the single-site rate.
* Accounts with three or more sites receive an automatic 10% discount on the combined multi-site total.
* The pilot pricing for a 90-day trial covering three busiest co-packer routes is a separate one-time cost.

For Stonebridge Orchards:

* The annual supply agreement renews at the same pricing, with volume discount tiers of 5% above 20 tonnes and 8% above 40 tonnes of fertiliser.
* Fuel and freight surcharges follow the quarterly index.
* Prices for seed and biologicals are fixed for the season once the order is confirmed.
* A 2% discount applies when an invoice is paid within 10 days.
* Standard orders ship on Tuesdays and Fridays, with cold chain orders shipping Monday to Thursday only.
* Pallets are 1.2 by 1.0 metres and carry at most 900 kilograms.
* Orders placed before 14:00 are picked the same day, with a missed delivery window rebooked at no charge once.
* The copper fungicide, the sulphur products, and the biological controls are allowed under the organic certification for the Willow Creek co-op.
* The re-entry interval (REI) for most fungicides in the Valley range is 12 hours, with 24 hours for copper-based products and 48 hours for the concentrated insecticide OV-Insect-40.
* The pre-harvest interval (PHI) for OV-Insect-40 is 14 days for stone fruit and 21 days for leafy greens.
